C# — Quoted

Intrinsic calibration, intrinsic-parameter writing, and factory-intrinsic restoration are available only on camera models and firmware that provide those APIs. Write operations use a complete CameraParametersConfig.

Correspond EpicEye.Calibration.Intrinsic.cs, for the identification of internal reference panels, management calibration, calculation of internal and external camera referencing, and independent examination of current internal accuracy.

API Reference

IdentifyBoard / IdentifyBoardAsync

Purpose: (b) Trigger the photograph and identify the type of internal reference plate, while returning the preview with the results of the test to confirm the type and visibility of the panel.

Parameters

Name Type Description

ip

string

Camera address.

timeout

int

Request timeout in milliseconds; Default: 30000.

Returns: ApiResponse<CalibrationBoardIdentifyResponse>See you in the field. Internal reference type.

CheckIntrinsicAccuracy / CheckIntrinsicAccuracyAsync

Purpose: Performs an independent internal nuance accuracy check, including filming, plate recognition, tablet position estimation, single camera re-projection error, and stereo alignment error calculation. The interface does not add images to the marked session.

Parameters

Name Type Description

ip

string

Camera address.

timeout

int

Request timeout in milliseconds; Default: 120000.

Returns: ApiResponse<IntrinsicAccuracyCheckResult>.

RemoveCalibImage / RemoveCalibImageAsync

Purpose: Removes the specified map pair from the current internal reference session and applies to the removal of a sample that is often masked, obscured or re-projected by error.

Purpose: Use all the charts left in the current session to calculate internal and external references and return the complete configuration that you can write to the camera.

  1. Call IdentifyBoard Identification of the type of plate and the effects of detection.

  2. After each repositioning and stabilization of the palette, confirm call by operator AddCalibImage. Each collection displays information on detection status, chart-to-index, tablet position, tilt and preview.

  3. IdentifyBoard, AddCalibImage and Calculate Overtime covers the full service-end process of camera filming, image transmission, panel testing and parameter calculation, not just the creation of HTTP _Other Organiser

Multi-Image Source Type

CalculateAsync Return full CameraParametersConfig.BinoWithColor Configuration of the aircraft type contains DepthSrc1, DepthSrc2 and TextureSrc; CameraParameters, ColorCameraParameters and corresponding error fields to check the calculation details. Use when writing a camera CameraParametersConfig.

Interactive Example

dotnet run --project examples/IntrinsicCalibration -- 10.10.11.33 4

The second parameter is the minimum valid graph logarithm required to allow the calculation, with the minimum value being 4; third parameter optional to specify known boardType. When the camera address is not specified,Example Search cameras and use the first device; if no plate is specified, call by operator IdentifyBoard.

Console operations are as follows:

  • C: confirm that the palette has moved to a new location and remains stable, and collect a set of maps.

  • K: retain a successful test and preview of an acceptable map pair;`R` Deletes this group and retakes it. The failure of the test is automatically deleted, the process is aborted and the calculation is disabled when the failure occurs.

  • After the number of valid maps is reached,K Using the currently retained data to calculate the reference,C Keep taping.

  • After the calculation is normal,W _Other Organiser`B` Back to collect,Q Quits and does not write.

Example: Write after confirmation

var calculation = await EpicEye.CalculateAsync(ip, timeout: 60000);
if (calculation.Status != 0 || calculation.Data?.CameraParametersConfig is null)
{
    Console.WriteLine(calculation.ErrorMessage);
    return;
}

Console.WriteLine($"Depth Double-eye RMS: {calculation.Data.StereoRms}");
if (calculation.Data.ColorStereoRms is double colorRms)
{
    Console.WriteLine($"Main Depth Camera-Colour Camera RMS: {colorRms}");
}
if (calculation.Data.ShouldWarnRms)
{
    Console.WriteLine("Mark RMS Beyond security threshold, not written to camera");
    return;
}

Console.Write("Confirm to write the full configuration above to the camera? W Write, other inputs cancel:");
if (!string.Equals(Console.ReadLine()?.Trim(), "W", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
{
    Console.WriteLine("Canceled, not written on camera");
    return;
}

var write = await EpicEye.SetCameraIntrinsicParametersAsync(ip, calculation.Data.CameraParametersConfig);
if (write.Status != 0 || write.Data != true)
{
    Console.WriteLine(write.ErrorMessage);
}

Example: Inline precision check

var check = await EpicEye.CheckIntrinsicAccuracyAsync(ip, timeout: 120000);
if (check.Status != 0 || check.Data is null)
{
    Console.WriteLine(check.ErrorMessage);
    return;
}

var result = check.Data;
Console.WriteLine($"Board: {result.BoardTypeDetected}, The position works.: {result.BoardPositionValid}");
Console.WriteLine($"Double-eye average/Max. Error: {result.StereoAveragePixelError:F3} / {result.StereoMaxPixelError:F3} px");
Console.WriteLine($"Check results: {(result.CameraAccuracyPass && result.StereoAveragePass && result.StereoMaxPass ? "It's through." : "Not adopted")}");
